┄ level ON PURPOSE (an open place, a fight place)
Every box is one 3.5 m battle square. The number in a square is its LEVEL (1 level = 1.75 m); lighter = higher. A black triangle = a RAMP square, pointing
uphill (one level over two squares).
A WHITE BAR with a tooth = a LEDGE: you hop DOWN across it (the tooth points down) and cannot climb back. That is how the walk works today: no new rule.
Plot lines by district: C = The Corn Fields · N = County Lane + its fields (not this plan's) · L = The Lake · R = The Ranch. Dashes = a new plot. Orange dots
= the ways out of the room; their squares keep today's height.
